coverage: Free keyless sources only (Wikimedia, OpenAlex, Crossref, Common Crawl). This is NOT a complete inbound-link picture: enumerating backlinks needs a paid index, and directory listings or blog mentions will not appear here.
filtering: OpenAlex and Crossref expose relevance search, not substring search, so a hit is kept only when the domain appears literally in the record. `discardedRelevanceHits` counts results the ranker returned that never mention the domain; a high number there is the filter working.
